known.header_value: {size} bytes: format version {v}, {n} chunks, random salt
known.meta: your file's name, type and real size, encrypted; we can't read it
known.size: padded, so the exact size stays hidden
known.ct_hash: a hash of the stored ciphertext
known.ip_what: used for this request and for rate limits kept in memory; never written to disk
known.never.name: the file's name, type and real size in readable form
known.never.email: an email address (we never ask for one)
known.stored_what: the file exactly as our disk holds it; this uses no open
known.stored_after: That's what we have. It's noise without the key.
claim.c5: We delete the ciphertext from our disk within a minute of its exit. If the exit was a download, we wait for it to finish (at most {ticket_min} minutes). We keep a note that the link existed for {tombstone_days} days, so we can tell you why it's gone. We never had the key, so any leftover bytes are noise.
claim.c5db: Our database (never files) is backed up daily and each copy is kept {db_backup_days} days. It holds the rows this panel prints.
claim.c5snap: Our host (Hostinger) can take weekly snapshots of the whole server. We haven't switched them off, and we haven't yet confirmed in its panel how long it keeps them. A file that existed when one was taken stays in it, as ciphertext, until that snapshot is rotated out.

send.failed: The delivery didn't go through ({code}). The file and its link are still here. Try again.
send.unsure: We couldn't confirm the delivery ({code}). It may still arrive: check with them before you try again.
claim.c8_relay: Our relay posted this payment for you, so we learned the address you sent to. Never the key.
claim.c8_direct: This browser built and paid for this payment. We passed it to the network, so we saw that your locker sent a transaction, not who it was for.
claim.c9_direct: Sends from your browser spend a grant from our sponsor wallet, then each send's change. Anyone reading the Ootle can link your sends to each other and to our sponsor wallet, but not see to whom or how much.
chain.unknown_tx: The indexers don't know this one. A testnet reset can wipe old history.
chain.amount_lower: at least {min} tTARI is public; the rest is hidden
chain.fee_note: Anyone can see the fee, and that it happened.
chain.direct_note: This button asks Tari's public indexer directly from your browser (and the second indexer only if the first doesn't answer). It's the only time {brand} contacts another site.
watch.title: See what a view key sees
watch.key_note: It stays in this tab. The key isn't sent anywhere.
watch.mine_placeholder: Your locker's view key, in this tab
watch.everything: Look at everything, not only the last week
watch.kind.sealed_file: a file for a locker: this key can't open it
watch.kind.file_link: a file for another wallet: this key opens it
watch.none_week: Nothing came in the last week.
watch.none_all: Nothing has come to this address.
inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.no_locker: Your inbox lives in your locker, and this browser has none yet.
inbox.scanning: Getting ready to check the Ootle…
inbox.scan_line: Checked {n} new outputs on the Ootle for ones only your locker opens · epoch {e}
inbox.empty: Nothing for you yet. Share your drop link, or your Tari address.
inbox.mirror_error: Couldn't reach the chain mirror. Retrying.
upgrade.title: Get more room
upgrade.lede: Free room is a fair share of one real disk. Need more? Rent it with test tTARI.
upgrade.free_body: A fair share of the disk. It changes every hour as more people use {brand}.
upgrade.address_note: Our receiving address with this invoice's reference inside it. The reference travels in the payment's encrypted memo, so the chain doesn't show which invoice was paid, or by whom.
upgrade.short_pending: Your browser's wallet is still waiting for its test grant. It takes a minute or two. Or let our demo wallet pay: demo tTARI from our sponsor wallet, and your browser signs nothing.
upgrade.short_refused: Your browser's wallet has no test grant today. Our demo wallet can pay instead: demo tTARI from our sponsor wallet, and your browser signs nothing.
pay.demo_note: Demo tTARI comes from our wallet. Your browser signs nothing.
upgrade.status.seen: We see the payment. Checking it on the chain.
upgrade.status.underpaid: We got {x} of {y} tTARI. Send the other {z} to the same address within {underpaid_days} days.
upgrade.status.expired: This invoice ran out of time. Nothing was paid. Make a new one.
claim.c11_proof: We credit a payment only after the official Tari library opens its commitment to the exact amount and a Tari-run public indexer shows it committed on the chain. A wallet saying “sent” isn't enough.
claim.c11_wallet: We credit a payment only after our wallet sees it and a Tari-run public indexer confirms it exists on the chain. The amount is the one our wallet reads.
claim.c15: A view key can't spend, but it can read everything sent to this address, including files. Give it only to someone allowed to see those.
verify.title: The goodbye record
verify.lede: Your browser checks each one against the record on the Tari™ chain.
verify.log: This log has no owner, so nobody, us included, can change its rules or the code behind it (template {template}). Only the key {writer} can add checkpoints.
verify.off: Receipts are off on this deployment, so there's nothing to check yet.
verify.untrusted: This SealLog component doesn't show what makes a log trustworthy (no owner, one writer key), so nothing was checked against it.
verify.none: There are no links on this device to check.
verify.ok: included at checkpoint #{index} (epoch {epoch}); the root matches the SealLog component on the Ootle.
verify.bad: the proof doesn't match the root on the Ootle. Please tell us.
verify.pending: not on the record yet; the next checkpoint is around {date}.
verify.say_one: Its goodbye on the Tari™ chain, checked by your browser.
verify.limit: It proves we said we deleted it, publicly and permanently. It can't prove we kept no copy.
verify.latest: The newest checkpoint on the Ootle: #{index}, at epoch {epoch}, with {count} records in its tree.
recent.h: Your recent links (only on this device)
noise.alt: The locked bytes of your file, drawn as dots.
testnet: {network} testnet: tTARI is test money, worth nothing. Ootle mainnet: {mainnet_date}.
testnet_live: {network} testnet: tTARI is test money, worth nothing. The Ootle mainnet is live; {brand} stays on the testnet until our code is reviewed.
error.bad_request: Something in that request didn't make sense to our server. Nothing changed. Reload and try again.
error.auth_required: Please open your locker again. Your files are safe.
error.bad_auth: That key didn't open a locker. Nothing changed. Open it again from your key file.
error.identity_exists: This locker already exists. Open it with its key.
error.forbidden: This link's key doesn't fit. Nothing opened, so nothing was used up.
error.bad_link: This link is incomplete or was changed.
error.bad_origin: This request didn't come from {brand}, so we ignored it.
error.conflict: That changed while you were looking. Reload to see the latest.
error.upload_broken: Oops. The upload broke. Try again.
error.upload_expired: Oops. The upload took too long, so we let it go. Try again.
error.already_opened: Already opened, so you can only make it stricter.
error.opened_count: Someone opened it already, so it stays this way. More rules can delete it now.
error.links_full: This file can't get another new link. Drop it again for a fresh start.
error.sold_out: Rented room is sold out for now. We'd rather say no than sell room we don't have. Free room still works.
error.too_large: That file is too big. The most is {max}. A free locker takes up to {probation} today, and {locker} from tomorrow.
error.too_large_drop: That file is too big. This drop takes up to {max}. Nothing was sent.
error.program_drop: Programs (.{ext}) can't be left in a drop. Links to them are a common trick, and we can't check what we can't see.
error.too_large_locker: That file is too big. Your locker takes up to {max}. Get more room, or split it.
error.too_large_request: A part of that upload was bigger than our server accepts at a time ({max}). Nothing was kept. Reload and try again.
error.locked: Too many wrong words. Try again in {wait}.
error.pow_required: The robot check ran out of time. Try again. It runs by itself.
error.rate_limited: Easy. You can do that again in {wait}.
error.byte_cap: This file has been downloaded a lot today, so we paused it to protect the disk. Try again tomorrow.
error.uploads_frozen: Our disk is nearly full, so new free uploads are paused. Existing links still work.
error.uploads_frozen_all: Our disk is nearly full, so all new uploads are paused. Existing links still work.
error.lane_full: The space for files without a locker is full right now. Small files and lockers still work.
error.quota_exceeded: Your locker is full. Delete something, or get more room.
error.probation_limit: Day-one lockers hold less. More from tomorrow, or get more room now.
error.chain_unavailable: The Ootle testnet isn't answering. Links still work; Tari features will be back when it is.
error.feature_disabled: That's switched off right now (usually during a testnet reset). File sharing still works.
error.budget_exhausted: Today's testnet budget for this is used up. Free features still work. Back at midnight UTC.
error.bad_address: That doesn't look like an Ootle address. Testnet addresses start with otl_esm_.
error.mainnet_address: That's not a testnet address. We run on the {network} testnet. Use an otl_esm_ address.
error.l1_address: That's a Tari base-layer address, like the ones Tari Universe shows. We run on the Ootle testnet. Open a free locker in one click to get an otl_esm_ address.
error.bad_blob: That delivery wasn't in the shape we expect, so we didn't send it. Nothing was paid.
error.unknown_pack: That plan doesn't exist anymore. Reload the page.
error.internal: Oops. Our server tripped. Try again in a minute.
error.client: Oops. Something broke in this tab. Reload and try again.
error.network: Oops. We couldn't reach our server. Try again.
error.crypto: This browser can't lock files. Try a new Firefox, Chrome or Safari.
error.memory: This device ran out of memory with that file. Try a smaller one, or a computer.
error.clipboard: Couldn't copy it. Select the link and copy it.
error.empty: That file is empty. There's nothing to lock.
error.folder: Folders can't be dropped yet. Zip it first.
error.many: One file at a time. Zip them first.
error.text_long: That's longer than {max} characters. Split it, or save it as a file.
error.program: Programs (.{ext}) need a free locker to send. Links to them are a common trick, and we can't check what we can't see.
error.needs_wasm: This needs WebAssembly, which your browser has turned off (Tor Browser's Safer level does this). Links without a locker still work.
error.needs_wasm_drop: Leaving a file here needs WebAssembly, which this browser has turned off. In Tor Browser, set the security level to Standard while you leave the file. An iPhone in Lockdown Mode may turn it off too: exclude this site in Safari's website settings.
error.integrity: This file didn't pass its check, so we stopped. It may have been changed. Nothing was saved.
error.read: We couldn't read that file. Choose it again.
error.wrong_password: That's not it. It stays locked.
error.keyfile: That's not a {brand} key. Check you pasted all of it, or choose the key file.
error.checksum: That key has a typo somewhere. Check it group by group.
error.locked_key: This key file is locked with a passphrase. Type it below.
error.wrong_passphrase: Wrong passphrase. The key file stays locked.
error.address_mismatch: That view key doesn't belong to this address.
error.view_key: That doesn't look like a view key. Paste it exactly as your locker showed it.
error.drop_limit: This browser already has as many drop links as it can keep open. Close one first.
error.insufficient: This browser's testnet wallet doesn't have enough tTARI for that.
error.timeout: The Ootle didn't confirm in time. Check again in a minute; nothing is sent twice.
error.rejected: The Ootle refused that transaction. Nothing was spent.
error.judge_spent: That judge pass is used up; the anti-bot check is back.
